text:
Your dynamic exam and assessment software has stopped working, and you need it restored quickly and reliably before the end of Feb. 2023.

I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning freelancer with 6 years of experience building and troubleshooting data-driven systems. My core tools include Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning workflows. I focus on getting systems working properly, keeping them maintainable, and making sure the final result is accurate and dependable.

In a telecom churn prediction project, I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers, along with per-customer SHAP reasons that the retention team could read. That model reached an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter and produced a top-decile lift of 3.1x. That work required careful feature handling, reliable model logic, and clear output that non-technical users could actually use—skills that translate well to a software system that needs to be stable and usable again.

For your assessment platform, I would approach the problem methodically: first identify where the failure is happening, then isolate whether it is a logic issue, data issue, dependency issue, or integration issue, and finally restore the software in a clean and testable way. I work efficiently and with integrity, so you can expect straightforward communication and focused troubleshooting until the system is back on track.

I understand the urgency of your timeline, and I would prioritize delivering a working solution as soon as possible while keeping the fix dependable. If there are any specific error messages, recent changes, or reproduction steps available, I can use those to move faster and narrow down the issue quickly.

If you’d like, I’m ready to help get your exam and assessment software functioning properly again.
